Inspired by the sunlit valley of the moon, California, Ojai evokes a moment suspended in golden light, where citrus groves, warmth, and quiet spirituality meet. Composed by master perfumer Cécile Zarokian, this fruity floral with an ambery depth opens with bergamot and a green note, warming into a radiant mango note at the heart alongside saffron and Bulgarian rose. 


Notes: 

  • Top: Bergamot, Green note, Cardamom
  • Heart: Mango, Bulgarian Rose, Saffron
  • Base: Patchouli, Frankincense, Vanilla

Scent: Fruity, Floral, and Ambery

Quantity: 100ml

 

Style: lobap7310

title: L'OBJET Alento Eau de Parfum 100ML
body_html:
Intimate and enveloping, Alento explores a quieter, inner dimension of scent. It captures the feeling of a deep breath between two moments, an invisible pause where warmth and life gently return. Like a suspended exhale, it lingers between presence and absence, softening time.


Notes:

  • Top: Orange, Aldehydes
  • Heart: Orange Blossom, Fresh Floral notes, Lactones
  • Base: Vanilla, Ambergris, White Musks

Scent: Floral and Gourmand

Quantity: 100ml
